name: classifier-direct
brief: Fix the off-by-one remaining-quota header on window reset.
requirements: AC-1: After reset, remaining quota reflects the new window minus the current request. Change type: fix.
solution: Reorder existing src/middleware/rate-limit.ts logic. No new components.

name: classifier-incremental
brief: Add a notification publishing API with durable idempotent delivery.
requirements: F1: publish notifications. AC-1: POST returns 202 and id. AC-2: invalid payload returns 422. AC-3: webhook retries five times. AC-4: idempotency key dedupes. AC-5: failed delivery is visible via GET.
solution: Two components: Notifications API and Notifications Repository. PostgreSQL persistence and an in-process delivery worker.

name: classifier-factory
requirements: Three capabilities: email/password authentication, refresh-token session management, and password reset. Eight acceptance criteria cover login, refresh, forgot, reset, lockout, audit, MFA prompt, and revocation.
solution: Auth Controller, Session Service, Password Service, and Email Service. Token and email work can proceed independently.

name: spec-with-both
brief: Validate SQL before execution with structured responses and rate limiting.
requirements: Syntax validation, injection rejection, reference extraction, structured response, complexity scoring, and rate limiting. Acceptance covers valid, injection, empty, and rate-limited requests.
solution: ValidationController, SQLParser, InjectionDetector, ComplexityScorer, RateLimiter. Existing parser dependency; application-level throttling.

name: spec-missing-sdd
brief: Add notifications, but explicitly review whether solution design can be omitted.
requirements: F1: WebSocket push. F2: email fallback. F3: channel preferences.

name: spec-validation-gaps
brief: Validate an incomplete health endpoint phase plan without auto-fixing it.
requirements: AC-1: GET /health returns 200 with version. AC-2: uptime in seconds.
solution: Health Controller exposes JSON through one new component. The phase-1 task lacks requirement section references; phase-2 exists but is unlisted in navigation. Both gaps must be reported, not treated as ready.

name: spec-single-feature
brief: Define incremental delivery for one notification capability.
requirements: Publish and persist notifications; deliver via webhook; support idempotent retry. Acceptance covers 202, 422, backoff, deduplication, and failed-state GET.
solution: Notifications API and Repository, PostgreSQL with idempotency constraint, and in-process polling worker. Public schema includes ID, topic, payload, key, state, attempts, created and updated timestamps.
